    private const val MILLIS_PER_SECOND = 1000

    /** Higher resolutions, hidden behind the "show higher resolutions" toggle. */

    /** Base playback resolutions, highest quality first, "best" pinned at the top. */

    /** Base mobile-data limit resolutions, "no limit" pinned at the top. */

        LIMIT_DATA_USAGE_NONE, "1080p60", "1080p", "720p60", "720p", "480p", "360p", "240p", "144p"
    )

    val AUDIO_FORMATS = listOf(AUDIO_M4A to "M4A", AUDIO_WEBM to "WebM")

    /** Seek durations in milliseconds, stored as strings like the legacy app. */
    val SEEK_DURATIONS_MS = listOf("5000", "10000", "15000", "20000", "25000", "30000")

    fun resolutions(showHigher: Boolean): List<String> =
        insertHighResolutions(BASE_RESOLUTIONS, showHigher)

    fun mobileDataResolutions(showHigher: Boolean): List<String> =
        insertHighResolutions(BASE_MOBILE_DATA_RESOLUTIONS, showHigher)

    fun seekDurationSeconds(durationMs: String): Int = durationMs.toInt() / MILLIS_PER_SECOND

    /** ExoPlayer can't inexact-seek in 5-second steps in audio, so those durations are hidden. */
    fun seekDurationsMs(inexactSeek: Boolean): List<String> = when {
        inexactSeek -> SEEK_DURATIONS_MS.filter { seekDurationSeconds(it) % 10 != 5 }
        else -> SEEK_DURATIONS_MS
    }
    /**
     * The seek duration to switch to when [inexactSeek] hides the currently selected
     * one, or null when no adjustment is needed.
     */
    fun adjustedSeekDurationMs(currentMs: String, inexactSeek: Boolean): String? {
        if (!inexactSeek) return null
        val seconds = seekDurationSeconds(currentMs)
        return if (seconds % 10 == 5) ((seconds + 5) * MILLIS_PER_SECOND).toString() else null
    }

    private fun insertHighResolutions(
        base: List<String>,
        showHigher: Boolean,
    ): List<String> {
        if (!showHigher) {
            return base
        }
        return base.toMutableList().apply {
            addAll(1, HIGH_RESOLUTIONS)
        }
    }

        BEST_RESOLUTION, "1080p60", "1080p", "720p60", "720p", "480p", "360p", "240p", "144p"
    )

    /** Base mobile-data limit resolutions, "no limit" pinned at the top. */
    val BASE_MOBILE_DATA_RESOLUTIONS = listOf(
        LIMIT_DATA_USAGE_NONE, "1080p60", "1080p", "720p60", "720p", "480p", "360p", "240p", "144p"
    )

    val VIDEO_FORMATS = listOf(VIDEO_MP4 to "MPEG-4", VIDEO_WEBM to "WebM", VIDEO_3GP to "3GP")

    val AUDIO_FORMATS = listOf(AUDIO_M4A to "M4A", AUDIO_WEBM to "WebM")

    /** Seek durations in milliseconds, stored as strings like the legacy app. */
    val SEEK_DURATIONS_MS = listOf("5000", "10000", "15000", "20000", "25000", "30000")

    fun resolutions(showHigher: Boolean): List<String> =
        insertHighResolutions(BASE_RESOLUTIONS, showHigher)

    fun mobileDataResolutions(showHigher: Boolean): List<String> =
        insertHighResolutions(BASE_MOBILE_DATA_RESOLUTIONS, showHigher)

    fun seekDurationSeconds(durationMs: String): Int = durationMs.toInt() / MILLIS_PER_SECOND

    /** ExoPlayer can't inexact-seek in 5-second steps in audio, so those durations are hidden. */
    fun seekDurationsMs(inexactSeek: Boolean): List<String> = when {
        inexactSeek -> SEEK_DURATIONS_MS.filter { seekDurationSeconds(it) % 10 != 5 }
        else -> SEEK_DURATIONS_MS
    }
    /**
     * The seek duration to switch to when [inexactSeek] hides the currently selected
     * one, or null when no adjustment is needed.
     */
    fun adjustedSeekDurationMs(currentMs: String, inexactSeek: Boolean): String? {
        if (!inexactSeek) return null
        val seconds = seekDurationSeconds(currentMs)
        return if (seconds % 10 == 5) ((seconds + 5) * MILLIS_PER_SECOND).toString() else null
    }

    private fun insertHighResolutions(
        base: List<String>,
        showHigher: Boolean,
    ): List<String> {
        if (!showHigher) {
            return base
        }
        return base.toMutableList().apply {
            addAll(1, HIGH_RESOLUTIONS)
        }
    }
}

        field = MutableStateFlow(storage.useStorageAccessFramework)

        field = stringFlow(KEY_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_VIDEO, DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER)

    val audioDownloadFolder: StateFlow<String>
        field = stringFlow(KEY_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_AUDIO, DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER)

    val fileCharset: StateFlow<String>
        field = stringFlow(KEY_FILE_CHARSET, DEFAULT_FILE_CHARSET)

    val replacementCharacter: StateFlow<String>
        field = stringFlow(KEY_REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER, DEFAULT_REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER)

    val maximumRetries: StateFlow<String>
        field = MutableStateFlow(repairedMaximumRetries())

        field = booleanFlow(
            KEY_PAUSE_ON_METERED_NETWORK,
            DEFAULT_PAUSE_ON_METERED_NETWORK
        )

        field = booleanFlow(KEY_LIMIT_QUEUE, DEFAULT_LIMIT_QUEUE)

    fun setStorageAsk(value: Boolean) = storageAsk
        .persist(KEY_STORAGE_ASK, value)

    fun setUseStorageAccessFramework(value: Boolean) {
        useStorageAccessFramework.persist(KEY_STORAGE_USE_SAF, value)

        if (value) {
            setVideoDownloadFolder(DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER)
            setAudioDownloadFolder(DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER)
            return
        }

        val defaults = storage.defaultDownloadFolders()
        if (videoDownloadFolder.value.isEmpty()) {
            setVideoDownloadFolder(defaults.video)
        }
        if (audioDownloadFolder.value.isEmpty()) {
            setAudioDownloadFolder(defaults.audio)
        }
    }

    fun setVideoDownloadFolder(value: String) = videoDownloadFolder
        .persistFolder(KEY_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_VIDEO, value)

    fun setAudioDownloadFolder(value: String) = audioDownloadFolder
        .persistFolder(KEY_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_AUDIO, value)

    fun setFileCharset(value: String) = fileCharset
        .persist(KEY_FILE_CHARSET, value)

    fun setReplacementCharacter(value: String) = replacementCharacter
        .persist(KEY_REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER, value)

    fun setMaximumRetries(value: String) = maximumRetries
        .persist(KEY_MAXIMUM_RETRIES, value)

    fun setPauseOnMeteredNetwork(value: Boolean) = pauseOnMeteredNetwork
        .persist(KEY_PAUSE_ON_METERED_NETWORK, value)

    fun setLimitQueue(value: Boolean) = limitQueue.persist(KEY_LIMIT_QUEUE, value)

    private fun stringFlow(key: String, defaultValue: String) = MutableStateFlow(
        settings.getString(key, defaultValue)
    )

    private fun booleanFlow(key: String, defaultValue: Boolean) = MutableStateFlow(
        settings.getBoolean(key, defaultValue)
    )

    private fun MutableStateFlow<String>.persist(key: String, newValue: String) {
        settings.putString(key, newValue)
        value = newValue
    }

    private fun MutableStateFlow<Boolean>.persist(key: String, newValue: Boolean) {
        settings.putBoolean(key, newValue)
        value = newValue
    }

    private fun MutableStateFlow<String>.persistFolder(key: String, newValue: String) {
        if (newValue.isEmpty()) {
            settings.remove(key)
        } else {
            settings.putString(key, newValue)
        }
        value = newValue
    }

    private fun repairedMaximumRetries(): String {
        val stored = settings.getString(KEY_MAXIMUM_RETRIES, DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_RETRIES)
        val repaired = normalizedMaximumRetries(stored)
        if (repaired != stored) {
            settings.putString(KEY_MAXIMUM_RETRIES, repaired)
        }
        return repaired
    }
}

        settings.putBoolean(key, newValue)
        value = newValue
    }
}

## What I changed

I scoped the work to the one thing I could both find concretely and **verify by building** — the settings ViewModels in the `shared` KMP module — rather than churning code I can't compile.

**The problem:** the four settings-screen ViewModels each re-implemented the same "`Settings`-backed `StateFlow` + persist-on-write" plumbing, and inconsistently:
- `VideoAudioSettingsViewModel`, `DownloadSettingsViewModel`, and `DebugSettingsViewModel` each declared their own private `stringFlow` / `booleanFlow` / `persist` helpers — duplicated nearly verbatim.
- `AppearanceSettingsViewModel` didn't use helpers at all; it hand-inlined `settings.getString/putString` plus `.value =` in every single property and setter.

**The fix:** extracted the shared plumbing into a small `SettingsBackedViewModel` base class (read-seeded flows + `persist` helpers) and had all four ViewModels extend it. Screen-specific logic (`persistFolder`, retry repair, resolution cleanup, theme-change side effects) stays in its own ViewModel.

```
AppearanceSettingsViewModel.kt   | 85 +++------------   (the big win — now consistent)
